horizonMeaning: Design and maintenance objective, not a guarantee of future scientific currency
coverage: H1 finite repository claim inventory and explicit context matrix complete; clinical evidence and independent software/reconstruction review remain open.

gates.name: Scope and weakness inventory
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current code, public claims, existing research and documented limitations with explicit audit boundaries
Assign every recorded material weakness an owner role, gate, next test and closure evidence requirement
Preserve G0–G4 status and freeze the new ordering without changing production behavior

closure.scope: Current code, advertised capabilities, research entrypoints and explicitly recorded known limitations only
closure.acceptanceReview: All three H0 criteria accounted for by the inventory, assigned weaknesses and preserved G0–G4 record; no assertion of comprehensive medical coverage

gates.name: Ontology and applicability
acceptanceCriteria: Reconcile every public scientific output, formula, heuristic and recommendation into stable claim IDs and declare the coverage denominator
Define quantities, units, observation/model/decision distinctions and temporal/measurement contexts
Complete an explicit claim-by-context matrix including clinical conditions, life stages, functional status, severity, treatment and intersections; mark every unreviewed cell
Verify any external terminology mapping and record its version and terms; retain unsupported and excluded scope without implying accuracy

closure.scope: 35 claim families across 48 primary surfaces at 8fb3728e453493fc99c7a43bbbdaf3e45a43f75e; 23 contexts and 805 cells; no clinical evidence or independent reconstruction closure
closure.acceptanceReview: All four H1 criteria reconciled in H1_INVENTORY.md. Units and field coverage checked against schemas and runtime. All applicability unknowns explicit. No external terminology mapping adopted; version and terms verification required before any adoption.

gates.name: Evidence currency and contradictions
acceptanceCriteria: Log reproducible primary-source and authoritative-guidance searches with date ranges, cutoffs and inaccessible material
Review source versions, corrections/retractions, applicability, rights and both supporting and contrary evidence
Record source inspected portions and actual review dates; adjudicate contradictions without silently pooling incompatible methods
Set claim-level evidence dispositions and next-review triggers; never derive currentness from document creation time

gates.name: Measurement and energy accounting
acceptanceCriteria: Audit reference calorimetry, body-composition inputs, preparation conditions, units and missingness for the intended comparison
Resolve or explicitly bound baseline, gross/net activity and step-membership assumptions without treating clock overlap as membership
Identify provider-specific semantics, measurement error and nonidentifiability; record unresolved cases and no-go rules

gates.name: External validity
acceptanceCriteria: Admit a relevant independent source with rights, exact identity, codebook, measurement conditions and independence checks
Freeze model comparisons, practical margins, exclusions, subgroup harms and uncertainty before new calculations; disclose previously seen published outcomes
Independently reproduce estimates, paired comparisons and intervals; publish negative findings and exact population limits
Record a versioned retain/change/no-go decision; do not tune on the evaluation cohort

gates.name: Readiness and decision boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Audit each current sleep, pain, fatigue and set-range rule against an explicitly defined outcome and intended population
Prespecify prospective performance outcomes, simple comparators, temporal/participant separation and adverse-use boundaries
Evaluate incremental predictive/decision value or formally retain/restrict unsupported guidance with a justified no-go and unresolved evidence needs
Separate educational reflection from prescriptions; no injury-safe or optimal-set claim without suitable evidence

gates.name: Uncertainty and individual value
acceptanceCriteria: For each track, require the applicable H4 or H5 scoped result or explicit no-go before individual inference
Distinguish sampling intervals, input sensitivity, measurement error, model error and individual prediction coverage
Evaluate personal calibration forward in time against a fixed baseline, accounting for intake error and fluid shifts; otherwise keep it unimplemented
Test comprehension and decision usefulness without manufacturing validated ranges; report harmful interpretations and non-improvement

gates.name: Software privacy and accessibility
acceptanceCriteria: Audit SDK, CLI, browser and direct-export contracts including malformed input, units, defaults and error propagation
Exercise sensitive-error/log handling, source admission, build portability and current external dependency assumptions
Verify keyboard, screen-reader labels, 320px layout and color-independent meaning with recorded methods and failures
Resolve high-consequence defects or enforce scope restrictions before changing user-facing decisions

gates.name: Reconstruction and maintenance
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce selected calculations and frozen-study artifacts from a clean checkout with environment and source rights recorded
Record a separate cold-start navigation exercise using only repository entrypoints; recover definitions, current/superseded decisions and next unblocked work
Rebuild an equivalent bounded calculation from preserved specifications and compare reference outputs; distinguish this from simply running existing code
Exercise a source update, contradiction, stale review and supersession scenario; preserve all unresolved H2–H6 limitations and record actual monitoring coverage

weaknesses.title: Whole-product claims exceed current measured validation
weaknesses.finding: G3 tests resting equations only; combined TDEE has no external accuracy evaluation.
weaknesses.nextTest: Map every energy output to an endpoint and independent reference method before choosing new data.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Clinical and physiological applicability is not systematically mapped
weaknesses.finding: The finite repository claim/context inventory is complete; context-specific clinical evidence remains unreviewed.
weaknesses.nextTest: Execute H2-A readiness/action source review, then remaining H2 queue; update claim/context dispositions only from inspected evidence.
weaknesses.residual: Mapping reduces ambiguity but does not establish clinical suitability or runtime exclusion detection.

weaknesses.title: Actionable readiness set bands remain unvalidated
weaknesses.finding: The core emits set ranges from selected heuristic thresholds without prospective outcome evidence.
weaknesses.nextTest: Inventory each rule and output; distinguish reflection guidance from an outcome or safety claim.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Measurement quality and accounting ambiguities remain
weaknesses.finding: BIA quality, baseline expenditure, gross/net MET and workout-step membership remain context-dependent.
weaknesses.nextTest: Trace reference/input method and component attribution before treating a model difference as deployable benefit.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Individual uncertainty and calibration are unestablished
weaknesses.finding: Cohort intervals and synthetic sensitivity are not individual error bounds.
weaknesses.nextTest: Define individual prediction target, observation horizon and a forward-time comparison before constructing a range.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Evidence freshness and contradiction handling lack an operational corpus
weaknesses.finding: Citations exist but source-level currentness and correction checks are not unified.
weaknesses.nextTest: Review high-consequence sources with dated searches and preserve counterevidence; do not stamp imported sources fresh.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Public research entrypoints had stale status statements
weaknesses.finding: research/README.md and llms.txt denied measured benchmark/results after G3; roadmap ordering needed reconciliation with the new priority.
weaknesses.nextTest: Reconcile current entrypoints and make the scoped baseline and future drift checks explicit.
weaknesses.residual: Future documentation drift remains possible; H8 must exercise maintenance.

weaknesses.title: Independent navigation and reconstruction are untested
weaknesses.finding: Agent pointers and fixtures exist; an independent reconstruction from specifications has not been demonstrated.
weaknesses.nextTest: Define and execute a clean-checkout and later independent navigation/reimplementation exercise.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: Full software adversarial and accessibility coverage is incomplete
weaknesses.finding: Existing tests and render checks do not establish full public-interface robustness, screen-reader access or privacy completeness.
weaknesses.nextTest: Audit direct exports, malformed inputs, defaults, sensitive errors and accessible interpretation with explicit test evidence.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

weaknesses.title: User comprehension and decision benefit are unmeasured
weaknesses.finding: A functioning UI and research results do not establish better individual decisions.
weaknesses.nextTest: Define comprehension and decision-usefulness questions; a reusable corpus remains valuable without a new feature.
weaknesses.residual: Evidence work remains; no claim of closure.

nextTask.action: Review readiness/action evidence and boundaries for C08, C14, C15, C16, C31, C34 and C35 using reproducible primary-source searches and explicit context dispositions

invariants: Do not reopen or tune completed G0–G4
No production formula or clinical scope change through planning status
No unreviewed clinical cell treated as validated
No automatic gate promotion from software checks
No private participant records in repository
No new dataset analysis before relevant scope/evidence/measurement gates
Research is independently valuable even without a shipped feature
